pr.body:
ActiveSegmentsV1 currently grows beyond the legacy journal limit, but its files cannot be archived and restored through the recovery API. This change adds a separately versioned 128-byte checkpoint and exact-directory backup, verification, and create-only restoration. Restored directories reopen through ordinary PoolStore replay and can continue genuine payments.

The archive retains read-only source handles with a shared genesis lock. It verifies complete physical frames and real authorization, copies every original file with fixed-size buffers, verifies the new target through its original owning handles, and checks source and target again before success. Existing targets are never overwritten; failures may retain a partial or complete new directory. The legacy recovery formats, limits, commands, IPC, and network activation remain unchanged.

Adds checkpoint-active, backup-active, verify-active, and restore-active. Regression tests cover strict pin bounds, an independent digest vector, readonly files and native locks, namespace replacements, copy interruption/receipt failure, rehashed invalid authorization, actual CLI backup/recovery followed by a genuine receiver payment, and recovery of a real multi-segment history through height 10002.

Frozen design: docs/ACTIVE_ARCHIVE_V1.zh-CN.md (SHA-256 de6d9639d724b777a8d4a937fa5e21b1b70880585ec8d0c0bf9336bff87a9cee).
Independent design review passed for that exact design; code acceptance is separate.

Validation status: source whitespace checks passed locally. This workspace has no Rust or Go toolchain. Native Ubuntu/Windows CI and a non-author exact-candidate implementation review are required before merge. This is a no-funds lab capability and does not establish finality, validator readiness, incremental backup, snapshots, production readiness, or an external security audit.
